post_hoc_observations.scope: Post-hoc observations only; these are not preregistered hypothesis results.

cooldown_observable_audit.disclosure: The audit found that the helper silently used fixed defaults of 47 W and 58.5 degC instead of requiring the preceding selected-device pre-run snapshot. The historical transitions pass under their actual baselines: run 1 pre 47 W/61.2 degC gives limits 52 W/64.2 degC for the 49 W/61.4 degC cooldown, and run 2 pre 48 W/61.2 degC gives limits 53 W/64.2 degC for the 47 W/61.5 degC cooldown. The selected-device telemetry.power gate remains distinct from retained telemetry.board_power at 121 W; immutable snapshots and the historical pass result are unchanged.

duration_audit.target_role: calibration/workload target, not a proven sustained-card-load minimum
duration_audit.card_load_duration_source: Each immutable calibration record: load_card_ticks / (actual_duration_aiclk_mhz * 1e6), using the time-weighted load-interval AICLK.
duration_audit.disclosure: The outer workload-process durations were approximately 299.151, 298.546, and 301.473 seconds, but measured card-load duration was approximately 276.08 seconds for each run. The 285-second target was not met in measured card-load time; no rerun was performed.
duration_audit.interpretation_consequence: The plateau and analysis artifacts are unchanged, but the results must not be interpreted as proof of a 285-second sustained-card-load minimum.

source.run_artifacts: The committed Q2 run traces, snapshots, and analyses; no run artifact was changed.
source.unit_disposition: Revision 5 post-measurement source inspection; no run artifact was changed.

board_power_plateau.delta_definition: signed plateau time-weighted mean minus 300 W

transient_at_approximately_4_5_seconds.observation: Each run has an approximately 4.5-second transient at about 1343 MHz, 210-212 W power, 254-257 A current, and 394-407 W board power.

next_sample_at_approximately_6_7_seconds.observation: The next approximately 6.7-second sample is 1031-1037 MHz with 292-297 W board power.

voltage_and_power_interpretation.relationship: Power is approximately voltage*current in these telemetry samples.
voltage_and_power_interpretation.limitation: This run cannot separate TDC from TDP.

load_plateau_evolution.observation: AICLK moves from approximately 1037 MHz toward 950-962 MHz while ASIC temperature rises from low-70s transition values to approximately 83 degC; board_power remains near 300 W.

THM_LIMIT_THROTTLE.interpretation: Raw snapshot value remains 0x5a; post-measurement tt-smi/tt-umd provenance establishes its semantic unit as degC through the direct therm_trip_l1 mapping. The raw value was not rewritten.

device_comparison.note: Issue #118 used device 0 whereas this Q2 measurement used host device 1/container-visible device 0; these are not directly the same device.

causality_and_next_intervention.requirement: A new preregistered intervention is required to test the board-power hypothesis.
causality_and_next_intervention.example: Change core count/load to get board power below 300 W, then compare the resulting AICLK and thermal behavior under the preregistered intervention.

before.definition: AICLK onset used the first left-held segment clipped at run_start whose AICLK was <= asic_fmax*0.95, so the pre-run idle 800 MHz row could make onset t=0.

after.definition: AICLK onset uses the first trace sample segment whose timestamp is at or after run_start (post-start sample only), with the same 1350*0.95=1282.5 threshold.

aiclk_onset_definitions.reason: Exclude pre-run idle from load-onset timing.
aiclk_onset_definitions.change_provenance: Post-measurement analysis change introduced by e09d4f9 after all 3 runs.
aiclk_onset_definitions.classification_comparison: The pre-change definition classified all three runs H-OTHER, and the post-change definition also classified all three H-OTHER; criteria and prediction did not change.

evidence.finding: The API documents TDC in amps.
Blackhole telemetry uses the raw low 16 bits of TDC for current without a unit conversion.
TDC_LIMIT_MAX is used directly as tdc_limit, while the telemetry table labels the paired current as A.
The API documents ASIC temperature in Celsius.
The paired Core Temp telemetry is labeled in degrees Celsius.
THM_LIMIT_THROTTLE is copied directly to therm_trip_l1_limit; no conversion is applied.
Core Temp is labeled in degrees Celsius and is shown with the thermal throttle/temperature limit.
The underlying ASIC temperature API is Celsius.

idle_snapshot.raw_reported_time_status: Unnormalized source field; the operator-stated acquired_at_utc is authoritative.
idle_snapshot.provenance: Manual idle read performed outside the Q2 harness; only sanitized board and telemetry fields are retained.

q2_device_1_snapshot_comparison.comparison_note: The supplemental record retains raw words and decoded channel bytes for every existing Q2 run pre/post snapshot and both cooldown snapshots; MAX_GDDR_TEMP remains raw-only with unknown unit.

issue_118_comparison.finding: Issue #118 has no GDDR temperature fields in the committed records.
issue_118_comparison.device_assignment: Issue #118 used device 0 while Q2 used device 1; the idle comparison is across different boards.
issue_118_comparison.thermal_limitation: The differing board thermal state means the AICLK difference cannot be attributed to run conditions alone.

board_thermal_confound.statement: Issue #118 used device 0 while Q2 used device 1. These are different boards with different idle thermal and fan states, so the AICLK comparison is confounded and cannot be attributed to run conditions alone.

interpretation: Any apparent fan-control/GDDR-temperature relationship is speculation, not proof: the inspected source establishes field decoding but does not establish fan-control causality from GDDR temperature.
The device-0 Issue #118 versus device-1 Q2 comparison is a board-thermal confound; the idle observation cannot establish why their run behavior differs.

source_provenance.finding: Raw telemetry words are emitted as hexadecimal; ASIC temperature is decoded as signed 16.16 and FAN_RPM low 16 bits are displayed as RPM.
ASIC temperature conversion divides signed fixed-point values by 65536.
The displayed fan telemetry is labeled RPM.
GDDR pair-word byte order and fan scalar/two-fan conditions are established; MAX_GDDR_TEMP remains unit/packing unknown.
The relevant telemetry tags are enumerated; source establishes GDDR pair-word bit positions and fan field semantics, but MAX_GDDR_TEMP unit and packing remain unknown.

limitations: MAX_GDDR_TEMP unit and packing are unknown; raw hexadecimal values are retained without conversion.
The operator-supplied idle snapshot is a single observation acquired outside the Q2 harness and is not a workload measurement.
The different device-0/device-1 boards and their thermal state confound direct attribution of AICLK behavior.
The source inspection does not establish a causal fan-control relationship with GDDR temperature.
gddr_fan_observation.source_status: Operator-supplied sanitized snapshot; local source inspection only.
gddr_fan_observation.source_inspection_scope: Local tt-smi 6.2.1 and tt-umd 0.9.8 source inspection only; no hardware access was used for this post-hoc update.

prediction.comparison: All three runs classified H-OTHER; H-TDP and H-THM were not supported, while current evidence made H-TDC not_supported under the fixed criteria.

limitations: The extended trace cadence is approximately 2 seconds; onset ordering has approximately 2-second resolution.
The AICLK onset is the first post-start sampled interval at or below 95% of source asic_fmax; no interpolation is performed.
The measurement is the ADR-0013 108-core Newton-Schulz surrogate and is not full enodia evidence.
Raw workload stdout/stderr remain local under ignored out/ directories; only byte counts and SHA-256 metadata are recorded here.

Outer workload-process duration exceeded the measured card-load interval: each run measured approximately 276.08 seconds against the 285-second target. No rerun was performed, so the results do not prove a 285-second sustained-card-load minimum.
